test_rule: all sorted image indices divisible by8
budget_extension_policy: user permits reasonable increases; only extend before test metrics if observed worker timings show pending frozen matrix needs more time; retain old plan/ledger and announce actual increase; no budget reset

matrix_per_scene.recipe: unchanged pinned native recipe; same MiDaS weights, train-only sparse initialization and pixel-origin correction

evaluation_order: all feasible training workers across all three scenes finish before opening any new test scores; then baseline standard, FSGS native, conversion, FSGS fsgs-native primary and FSGS standard secondary

quality_policy.recommendation: recommend per scene when any meaningful gain with bounded losses fits measured resource budget; otherwise report conditional use or no recommendation, retaining every negative; not all metrics must improve
quality_policy.single_seed_limit: one seed per scene; sample statistics, not population guarantees

preparation_failure_policy: preserve failed scene; do not substitute views, random initialization or another scene; continue other fixed scenes
profile_comparability: fortress primary used standard FSGS rendering; do not silently pool differently-profiled means; retain standard secondary for all three scenes
execution_order_reason: horns network recovery runs independently; orchids/trex preparation already complete; all training still precedes any test scores; no data/algorithm changes
